newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CYCLING-DENMARK'S SORENSEN WINS TOUR OF FLANDERS.
newsitem.headline: CYCLING-DENMARK'S SORENSEN WINS TOUR OF FLANDERS.

text.p: A blistering sprint finish on Sunday saw Rolf Sorensen become the first Dane to win the 256-km Tour of Flanders.
Sorensen broke clear with one kilometre to go. Frederic Moncassin of France was second and Italian Franco Ballerini third.
Sorensen was in the leading pack for much of the World Cup event after breaking midway alongside Frenchman Laurent Jalabert, whose challenge faded on the course's famed cobblestoned hills.
Belgian Johan Museeuw saw his dream of winning the race for the third time dashed 30 kms from the finish when his bike was wrecked in a collision with Italian Bruno Boscardin.
